added_lines: # allow before required final arg that must be path
# --line can only be the first arg
# If head not given, use current branch (HEAD),
# and blame will use worktree if there is one.
show_parse_err [mc "fatal: no such file '%s' in worktree" $path]
show_parse_err [mc "fatal: '%s' is not a valid rev'" $head]
# check path is known in head, and is file / directory as required
# ls-tree gives contents of root-dir, we need root-dir itself
[mc "'%s' is not a directory in rev '%s'" $path $head]}
[mc "'%s' is not a filename in rev '%s'" $path $head]}
deleted_lines: -message [mc "fatal: cannot stat path %s: No such file or directory" $path]
context_lines: # -- Not a normal commit type invocation?  Do that instead!

matched_surfaces.name: cli_options
matched_surfaces.description: CLI commands, options, parsing, defaults, exit codes, and output.

matched_surfaces.name: user_visible_output
matched_surfaces.description: User-visible output, diagnostics, and log text.
